title: Mobility and periodic registration update initiation

entities.name: Mobility and Periodic Registration Update
entities.description: Registration procedure initiated by UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED state for mobility updates or periodic registration. UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST message to AMF under various conditions.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to AMF to initiate mobility and periodic registration update procedure.

entities.name: 5GS registration type
entities.description: IE indicating type of registration update: mobility registration updating, periodic registration updating, or disaster roaming mobility registration updating.

entities.name: 5GMM capability
entities.description: IE containing UE's 5GMM capabilities including support for various features like S1 mode, LPP, LCS, RACS, 5G-SRVCC, etc.

entities.name: T3512
entities.description: Periodic registration updating timer that triggers registration procedure when it expires in 5GMM-IDLE mode.

entities.name: T3510
entities.description: Timer started by UE after sending REGISTRATION REQUEST message to AMF.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where UE is registered with the network and can initiate mobility and periodic registration update procedures.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE
entities.description: UE state where UE is registered but has no active NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Current TAI not in registered TAI list
entities.description: Condition triggering registration procedure when UE detects current TAI is not in previously registered tracking area list.

entities.name: T3512 timer expires
entities.description: Condition triggering periodic registration update when T3512 timer expires in 5GMM-IDLE mode.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI
entities.description: IE containing S-NSSAI(s) corresponding to network slices UE intends to register to.

entities.name: 5GS mobile identity
entities.description: IE containing UE identity such as 5G-GUTI or mapped 5G-GUTI from 4G-GUTI.

entities.name: MICO indication
entities.description: IE used by UE to request use of MICO mode or indicate support for strictly periodic registration timer.

entities.name: Uplink data status
entities.description: IE indicating PDU sessions with pending user data to be sent over user plane.

relations.description: Registration procedure is initiated by sending REGISTRATION REQUEST message
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS registration type IE
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GMM capability IE
REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Requested NSSAI IE
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS mobile identity IE
REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain MICO indication IE
REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Uplink data status IE
Registration procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state
Condition triggers registration procedure when current TAI not in registered list
Condition triggers registration procedure when T3512 timer expires
Registration procedure starts timer T3510 after sending REGISTRATION REQUEST
When T3512 expires is only reason, UE sets registration type to periodic registration updating
